tools.name: evaluate_trade
tools.description: Judge an NFL fantasy football trade (dynasty or redraft): who wins, how confident the verdict is, the value of every player and pick on each side, the reasons, and what would even it out. Use for "is this trade fair?", "who wins this trade?", "should I accept?". Returns a link that opens the trade i

tools.name: get_player_values
tools.description: Current trade value of one or more NFL players for a fantasy football league: value on a 0 to 10,000 scale with a likely range, overall and position rank, projected points per game and the change over the last week. Use to compare players or answer "what is X worth?".

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Fantasy football trade-value rankings for a league format (dynasty or redraft, Superflex or 1QB), for all positions or one of QB, RB, WR, TE. Returns rank, value and one-week change, 25 players at a time by default.

tools.name: suggest_fair_trade_returns
tools.description: Given the players or picks on one side of a fantasy football trade, list fair returns for them: straight swaps, two-player packages, a player plus a pick, and picks only. Use for "what can I get for X?" or "what should I offer for X?".

tools.name: get_rookie_pick_values
tools.description: Trade values of dynasty rookie draft picks for the next three drafts, rounds 1 to 4, each as early, mid and late, with the veteran player of similar value. Dynasty leagues only.
